title: Electric Waves: Being Researches on the Propagation of Electric Action with Finite Velocity through Space
version: Dover 1962 unabridged reprint of authorized English translation, 1893; scanned copy hosted by Princeton.
lineage: Primary papers and first-person retrospective introduction in authorized translation. Qualitative wave evidence is separated from Hertz’s later-disavowed quantitative air/wire comparison.

passages.note: Introduction A, printed pp. 1–7: Berlin 1879 problem; 1886 apparatus opportunity; design and revision of 1887 dielectric tests; November 10 report.
Introduction A pp. 11–12: wavelength/velocity measurement qualifications; Introduction B p. 20: Helmholtz rather than direct guidance from Maxwell’s book.
Paper II pp. 29–33: rapid-oscillation apparatus and spark conditions.
Paper VIII pp. 124–127, 132–136: air-wave reflection experiment, reuse of primary conductor, spark-gap circle and limitations.
